name: eCential Robotics
description: eCential Robotics (formerly Surgivisio) is a medical robotics company founded in 2009 in Gières (Grenoble), France. The company develops the [eCential Robotics](/robot/ecential_robotics_platform) unified intraoperative 2D/3D X-ray imaging, optical navigation, and robotic guidance platform for spine and orthopedic surgery (built on the [KUKA](/company/kuka) [LBR Med](/robot/kuka_lbr_med) arm and co-developed with DePuy Synthes / [Johnson & Johnson MedTech](/company/johnson_johnson_medtech) from 2022 to 2024 as VELYS Spine).
